name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Marketing Automation & Email | HubSpot Workflows, Segmentation, Lead Scoring & Testing
summary: Hands-on marketing automation builder with 5+ years designing CRM and email automation, including HubSpot builds with segmentation, lifecycle stages, and data-hygiene rules. Built 20+ automated lifecycle workflows and a scoring workflow that rated 180+ prospects and triggered personalized outreach. Builds landing pages and forms, runs A/B tests, and turns results into clear next steps.

experience.title: Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead
bullets: Architect and implement CRM and automation systems in HubSpot and GoHighLevel, including contact segmentation, lifecycle stages, lead routing, and strict data-hygiene protocols.
Built and deployed 20+ automated email and SMS workflows spanning lead capture and tagging, qualification, booking, no-show recovery, onboarding nurture, reactivation, and review generation.
Built an automated scoring workflow that rated 180+ businesses on their digital footprint and triggered segmented, personalized email outreach based on the score.
Build landing pages, forms, and email sequences and write the copy; hands-on HTML/CSS on the company site and client tracking implementations.

experience.title: Account Executive / Client Strategist
bullets: Produced complex email sequences, landing pages, and conversion-focused copy that improved lead generation.
Built campaign reporting on ROI, CAC, LTV, and conversion, ran A/B-tested campaigns, and delivered recommendations in QBRs.

experience.title: Channel Partnerships & Customer Onboarding
bullets: Built automated product-training sequences and communication workflows for a 15-20 partner network, retaining all but one (~94%).

experience.title: Account Executive / Sales Operations
bullets: Ran client accounts in HubSpot at a performance marketing agency, improving reporting accuracy and reducing handoff errors.

experience.title: Account Manager, Onboarding Launch Specialist & Team Lead
bullets: Defined the Salesforce fields for outbound and onboarding workflows and advised on A/B test structure for a Salesforce workflow-automation effort.

education: B.A. Liberal Arts, Minor in Political Science - Colorado State University, Fort Collins, CO
